question: Which city hosted the first Indian Grand Prix athletics meet in March 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The city of **Bengaluru** was chosen to host the **first Indian Grand Prix (IGP)** athletics meet of the **2025** season, scheduled to take place in **March 2025**.
 
• The event is organized under the aegis of the **Athletics Federation of India (AFI)**, which is the apex body for managing athletics in the **country**.
 
• The **Sree Kanteerava Stadium** in **Bengaluru** serves as the primary venue for this high-profile competition, featuring top Indian athletes across various track and field disciplines.
 
• The **Indian Grand Prix** series is a crucial part of the domestic calendar, providing athletes with the opportunity to achieve **qualification standards** for major international events such as the **World Athletics Championships** and other continental meets.
 
• The **first leg** of the **2025** series in **Bengaluru** focuses on identifying early-season form and allowing athletes to test their training progress after the winter off-season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Athletics Federation of India (AFI):**
 
 
• The **AFI** was formed in **1946** and is responsible for the development and promotion of athletics in **India**.
 
• It is affiliated with **World Athletics**, the **Asian Athletics Association (AAA)**, and the **Indian Olympic Association**.
 
• The headquarters of the **AFI** is located in **New Delhi**.
 
 
 
• **Structure of the Indian Grand Prix:**
 
 
• The **IGP** is typically conducted in multiple legs (e.g., **IGP 1, IGP 2, IGP 3, and IGP 4**) across different cities to ensure wide geographical participation.
 
• Cities like **Thiruvananthapuram**, **Patiala**, and **Bhubaneswar** are other prominent hosts for subsequent legs of the series.
 
• The competition includes events such as **100m, 200m, 400m, 800m**, **Long Jump**, **Shot Put**, and **Javelin Throw**.
 
 
 
• **Bengaluru as a Sports Hub:**
 
 
• **Bengaluru** is home to the **Sports Authority of India (SAI)** Netaji Subhas Southern Centre, which is a premier training base for Indian track and field athletes.
 
• The city's **moderate climate** and **elevation** make it an ideal location for middle and long-distance runners to train and compete.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Role of the Meet:** The **March 2025** meet acts as a **season opener**, allowing the **National Selection Committee** to monitor the performance of athletes under the **National Coaching Camps**.
 
• **Anti-Doping Measures:** During the **Indian Grand Prix**, the **National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA)** actively conducts testing to ensure a clean sporting environment and adherence to **WADA** guidelines.
 
• **Technological Integration:** Modern meets in **India** now utilize advanced **electronic timing systems** and **photo-finish technology** to ensure accuracy in record-keeping for **national records**.
 
• **Key Participants:** Expected participants in such meets often include high-profile names in Indian athletics, including those who have represented **India** in the **Olympics** and **Asian Games**.
